experiment: D65 (TODO FEC-R06): score-weighted tail table and input clipping audit of the deployed heads
kind: measurement only; nothing fitted, nothing selected, no candidate
entrant_word: 2026-10-14 'dohodnite sa s second_agentom a skúsme čo sa dá, nemáme čo stratiť' (research reopened; #986068 preserved)
cohort: the 358 D38 development shots (120 screening + 238 used by D43); EXPOSED many times, not confirmation data
answers: D39 cache: held-out raw answers of the deployed 69 map networks, 4 tree heads, 8 joint scalar networks (no network fitted on these shots)
deployed_heads: labels + tree blend at li .26, r_axis .14, kappa .09, x_lower_r .16; q95 = .54 map + .46 joint; betaN = .13 map + .87 joint (D61 shares)
truth: q95, betaN from the shot file (efit_q95, efit_beta_n); r_axis, z_axis, kappa, tri_top, tri_bot, volume, li from the organisers' derivation on the true map (D32 references)
clipping: standardised input z = (feature - feature_mean) / feature_scale for every deployed network (69 map, 8 joint, 8 X); a frame is clipped for a network when any |z| > 8; per frame: share of the 85 networks for which it is clipped, and the clipped feature indices
tables: per target: SSE share and frame share of clipped frames (any network) and of frames clipped for >= half the networks
per target: worst 0.1 %, 1 %, 5 % frames and worst 10 shots with their clipping, Ip, position in record, time to record end
per target: SSE share of the last 3 frames and last 0.5 s of each record
feature indices most often clipped, overall and in the worst 1 % frames of each target
decision_rule: Clipping is named a candidate mechanism for target T (and an R07 matched test of wider or no clipping is proposed for T) only if frames clipped for >= half the networks hold >= 10 % of T's SSE AND their SSE share is >= 3 x their frame share. Otherwise the clipping hypothesis is closed for T at this resolution (358 exposed shots). The tail table is reported either way.
compute: ML350, systemd-run user unit, MemoryMax 16G, MemorySwapMax 0, 2 worker processes (D63 holds 22 threads)
